en: Surely you can make use of this device?
ja: この道具、君なら使えるだろう?

key: I hear Trainers often find it helpful.
en: I hear Trainers often find it helpful.
ja: トレーナーにはよく役立つと聞くよ。

key: KID: Take good care of it, okay?
en: KID: Take good care of it, okay?
ja: 子供: 大事にしてね?

key: And don't eat any candy you find with it!
en: And don't eat any candy you find with it!
ja: それで見つけたアメは食べちゃだめだよ!

key: Maybe vegetables are okay?
en: Maybe vegetables are okay?
ja: 野菜なら平気かな?

key: ???: ...I can only trust that you will make good decisions about what you find with that device.
en: ???: ...I can only trust that you will make good decisions about what you find with that device.
ja: ???: …その道具で見つけたものについては、君が正しい判断をしてくれると信じるしかないな。

key: As for you,
en: As for you,
ja: それで、君は、

key: Let us be off to your new home.
en: Let us be off to your new home.
ja: 新しい住まいへ向かおう。

key: We'll get you a nice, warm meal with actual nutritional value.
en: We'll get you a nice, warm meal with actual nutritional value.
ja: ちゃんと栄養のある、温かい食事を用意してあげよう。

key: Follow me; I'll escort you there at once.
en: Follow me; I'll escort you there at once.
ja: ついておいで。すぐに案内するから。

key: Pardon, stranger.
en: Pardon, stranger.
ja: 失礼、見慣れない顔だな。

key: Do you mind?
en: Do you mind?
ja: ちょっといいか?

key: No one gives us the time of day but to invade our space.
en: No one gives us the time of day but to invade our space.
ja: 誰もこっちの都合なんて考えず、勝手に縄張りに入ってくるばかりだ。

key: The rest of the city flourishes, and we still come here at the end of the day.
en: The rest of the city flourishes, and we still come here at the end of the day.
ja: 街の他の場所は栄えてるってのに、俺たちは結局ここに戻ってくるしかない。

key: But there's no use in moralizing to the masses.
en: But there's no use in moralizing to the masses.
ja: でも大衆に説教したって意味ないけどな。

key: They don't understand what it's like to have to walk miles in our shoes.
en: They don't understand what it's like to have to walk miles in our shoes.
ja: あいつらには、俺たちの立場で何マイルも歩く気持ちなんてわからねえよ。

key: Without experience, how could anyone understand?
en: Without experience, how could anyone understand?
ja: 経験なくして、誰がわかるっていうんだ?

key: You really wanna know what's like to come up short at every opportunity?
en: You really wanna know what's like to come up short at every opportunity?
ja: チャンスがあるたびに足りないってのがどんな感じか、本当に知りたいか?

key: Next time someone asks you for a password, tell them "emptyivs".
en: Next time someone asks you for a password, tell them "emptyivs".
ja: 今度誰かにパスワードを聞かれたら、「emptyivs」って伝えてくれ。

key: I imagine then even your Pokémon will understand the hollow burn of misfortune.
en: I imagine then even your Pokémon will understand the hollow burn of misfortune.
ja: そうすれば、お前のポケモンにも不運の空虚な痛みってのがわかるだろうさ。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
